comments.post_title: IELTS Speaking Part 2: describe a walk
comments.text:
here's my answer and I wish you take sometimes to find out some mistakes from my answer.

I would like to talk to you about a long walk I enjoyed. It happened a few months ago when I was coming back the hostel with my girlfriend after school. This time was quite late because we attended English class in the evening. As usual, we took forty minutes by motor to get there. Suddenly,the tyre of motorbike was broken and we couldn't go anymore. It took place on Cau Giay Street in HaNoi,which is about 2 km far from our destination.I didn't know what would occur and wondered when we could arrive our hostel. No one went around and helped us to handle this trouble because of being late-night, so my girlfriend and I had to go for a long walk as we had no choice. At the beginning,we felt powerless after a hard day at studying and didn't want to move. However,on the way of walking home, we realised it was really interesting to walk and see something happening in the street. Some restaurants still opened and its smell reminded me about my childhood when my mother always cooked some delicious cuisine for me. We liked the peaceful and quiet atmosphere there that we had never seen before at the big city. It was also good chance for us to talk about our families,hobbies and even the lessons we had been studying. I told joke,both of us smiled all the time. Finally, we could arrive our hostel, it seemed shorter than we thought.I suppose that I will never forget that time and the long walk we went with each other.

comments.author: Ana
comments.post_title: IELTS Speaking Part 2: describe a walk
comments.text:
Hi Vinodha,

It might be probably too late, but it is good to read any literature you like in english. Reading a single book in original language (english) will improve your understanding and speed of reading. In terms of IELTS reading you should always look on questions first and underline some key words you might meet in text. Then start reading from the beginning and stop each time you meet that information from questions and try to solve them. I also had some problems with reading in the past, this technique helped me to improve my score. And of course pay attention on vocabulary, good vocabulary is the main key to high score.

Good luck with your test.

comments.author: Kit
comments.post_title: IELTS Speaking Part 2: describe a walk
comments.text:
Describe a long walk that you enjoyed.

You should say

- when you went on this walk

\- where it took place

\- what you saw while you were walking

\- and explain why you enjoyed the walk.

Last Saturday, I went to a beach with my family.

It took three hours drive from where I lived. When I arrived the beach area, I was thrilled by the amazing scenery of the sea. I had the priviledged to witness the beauty of a sunrise. The sun was glaring and the sea breeze was cooling.

When I was walking along the beach, there were already so many people walking their dogs, jogging and there are a few people who were just sitting on the beach.

While I was walking with my family, I suddenly observed a flock of birds in the sky. They were flying in a triangle shape. There was only one bird that led the whole flock of birds at that time. As I continued strolling along the beach, suddenly I saw the bird that was leading the rest of them, began to reposition itself and let other bird to take its turn to lead.

It was amazing ! I thought even the birds knew how to work in unity. That's the reason why I enjoyed my walked in the nature.The nature was fascinating and it always has a suprised for me and taught me with a new lesson too.

Hi Mr.Simon,

I've just received my ielts test result ..I'm so happy to say that I've passed it.. And I would say without your posts and help it might be impossible to pass it from the first attempt in UK. Actually I had the test a couple of years ago in my country and my result was : L 6.0 R 6.0 W 5.5 S 7.0 overall 6.0

I felt that I'm not going to score overall 7.5 so I had stopped reading ielts from that attempt.

Recently I moved to Cardiff with my husband and my supervisor advised me that the only way to have training in UK is to get 7.5 in ielts with minimum 7.0 in each part before being able to sit for PLAB test, so I started to prepare for Ielts for 2 months only using your website I was making notes and comments about each passage or information you gave, I listened to TED videos you have posted and whenever I finish the listening practice I got into the habit of writing down what I had heard .This technique helped me a lot to improve my vocabulary and grammar .I sat for the exam on 7th November and I've achieved overall 7.5

L 8.0 R. 7.0 W 7.0 S 7.0

Thanks a lot dear Simon may God bless you.. you make my dream come true.. And I would like to thank Martin and Sjm as well their posts were quite helpful ..I wish all the best for all the future candidates ..

Sincerely,

body:
Try preparing an answer for the following task:

_**Describe a long walk that you enjoyed.**_

_**You should say**_

_**\- when you went on this walk**_

_**\- where it took place**_

_**\- what you saw while you were walking**_

_**\- and explain why you enjoyed the walk.**_

Tip: Maybe you can use a topic that you have already prepared e.g. description of a holiday, or a city that you have visited.
